stage: Transport smoke only; before any evaluation-case model output
trigger: The first direct-mode G smoke response chose the wrong window but truthfully reported that window's measured peak bins. The original scoring implementation incorrectly counted disagreement with the optimal-window values as an unsupported numeric claim.
correction: Judge reported numeric values against cited measurements at the REPORTED window. Score optimal-window selection separately. Wrong-setting decisions remain failures of the primary endpoint but truthful wrong-setting values are not labeled fabricated.
test: A deliberately wrong 256 ms configuration with accurately cited measurements must fail setting correctness and strict success while passing numeric support.
preservation: Retain the original smoke scores and events; use the corrected evaluator for the scored evaluation and identify this amendment in its freeze record.
